Record a decision about a flag

Source: R/pipeline.R
acknowledge.Rd

acknowledge() records that a flag was looked at and the pipeline may move on; it is meant for info and review flags. override() records a decision to continue despite a block flag (or any other flag) and needs a written reason. Both are logged with the time and the note, and the report from pipeline_report() lists them. Choose flags by id, check, target or level; with none of these, every open flag that the function can take is chosen.

Usage

acknowledge(p, id = NULL, check = NULL, target = NULL, level = NULL, note = "")

override(p, id = NULL, check = NULL, target = NULL, level = NULL, note)

Arguments

p

a pipeline from mv_pipeline().

id

flag numbers, as shown by flags().

check

names of checks, e.g. "item_misfit".

target

items (or other targets) the flags are about.

level

levels to choose, e.g. "review".

note

the reason for the decision. Required for override().

Value

The pipeline, with the chosen flags' status changed.

Details

To fix a problem instead, remove the item with drop_items() or rerun the stage with corrected input; flags that no longer apply disappear.

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- add_responses(mv_pipeline(), certexam, items = 3:34, key = certexam_key)
p <- acknowledge(p, level = "review", note = "Checked with the content team")
#> Warning: No open flags match; nothing was acknowledged.
p <- override(p, check = "possible_miskey",
              note = "Keep Q14 until the item writer replies")
flags(p, status = "all")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>      id stage  check           target value      rule  level advice status note 
#>   <int> <chr>  <chr>           <chr>  <chr>      <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>  <chr>
#> 1     1 intake possible_miskey Q14    p = 0.18,… p < … block Check… overr… Keep…
# }
